notes.title: Now the game is acceptable, but don’t expect a perfect game in every aspect.
notes.notes: [p][b]I’m sorry if some people were expecting a much more extensive game than what it already is in terms of details[/b][/p][p]The truth is, if you want to do something much better in Latin America, it can be costly if you don’t have a team of experts working with you. This is the best that can be done with almost no budget. That’s why I’d like to use a more documented engine with more features in the future, to create more interesting games than this one. For now, I’ve fixed all the most important issues — but watch out for the map of the fat dragon, 'Corpulento' It can still cause some problems, but it’s manageable if you know what to do.[/p][p]Finally, the supposed "anthropomorphic dinosaurs" that you saw, are not really that in the lore, this is a "Peculiar" detail of the lore of the "World of Hartdam"[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550743/b032e2560b6f2f23d8466004e9159951a143aa27.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p]
